notes: Dates verified against official vendor pages on 2026-09-23. Windows: Microsoft pages show end times as 'M/D/YYYY 6:59:59 AM' PT of the day after the last Patch Tuesday; stored value is the last supported day (the Patch Tuesday, i.e. page date minus one day). Windows endOfSupport = Extended End Date. RHEL endOfMainstream = end of Full Support, endOfSupport = end of Maintenance Support (ELS excluded). Ubuntu and Proxmox pages give month precision only; stored as last day of month and flagged datePrecision=month. Debian endOfSupport = end of regular Debian security support, endOfLts = end of Debian LTS (ELTS excluded). null means not confirmed on an official page. Azure Stack HCI / Azure Local omitted (Modern Lifecycle, per-version servicing; build mapping unclear). Treat a date as 'supported through end of that day'.

windows-server.rule: exact string match of BuildNumber to branch (e.g. '17763'). Also require ProductType != 1 (server) to avoid matching client Windows builds that share a number (e.g. 26100 is also Windows 11 24H2, 14393 is also Windows 10 1607, 17763 is Windows 10 1809).

linux.rule: rhel/rocky/almalinux/debian: branch = VERSION_ID split on '.' take first part ('9.4' -> '9', '12' -> '12'). ubuntu: branch = full VERSION_ID ('22.04'). Only Ubuntu LTS releases are listed; non-LTS VERSION_IDs have no entry.

proxmox-ve.rule: branch = major version X. /etc/os-release reports the Debian base (ID=debian), so check Proxmox first.
